en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, grand hotel or sanatorium‑style building on a hill, surrounded by fields, scattered trees, and a forested ridge in the background. The multi‑storey structure has steep, gabled roofs with dormer windows, long balconies and verandas, and appears to overlook a rural landscape. A simple wooden fence and foreground vegetation frame the scene.
